question:
Spot the error.

The clerk said me that he had not seen (A) / the file anywhere in the office (B) / since the previous afternoon. (C)

options.text: The clerk said me that he had not seen
the file anywhere in the office

explanation: 'Say' के बाद सीधे object नहीं आता। Listener (object) हो तो 'tell' लगता है: 'said me that' → 'told me that'।

question:
Spot the error.

Our hostess politely asked me (A) / whether did I want (B) / tea or coffee with the dinner. (C)

options.text: tea or coffee with the dinner.

explanation: Reported question में statement order (subject + verb) रहता है, auxiliary पहले नहीं आती: 'whether I wanted'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The teacher asked the boy [what was his name] and where he lived.
explanation: Reported wh-question में सीधा order आता है: 'what his name was' (न कि 'what was his name')।

question:
Spot the error.

The geography teacher told the students (A) / that the earth moves round the sun (B) / and rotates on its own axis. (C)

options.text: The geography teacher told the students
that the earth moves round the sun
and rotates on its own axis.

explanation: Universal truth / habitual fact reported speech में नहीं बदलता, इसलिए reporting verb past होने पर भी 'moves' (present) सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The captain told the players that [you should not lose heart] even if they lost the first match.
explanation: Reported speech में second person pronoun (you) listener के अनुसार बदलता है। Listener 'the players' हैं, इसलिए 'you' → 'they'।

question:
Spot the error.

Two years ago, the minister told the villagers (A) / that he had visited their village yesterday (B) / and promised to build a road. (C)

options.text: Two years ago, the minister told the villagers
that he had visited their village yesterday
and promised to build a road.

explanation: Reported speech में 'yesterday' → 'the previous day / the day before' हो जाता है। Past Perfect (had visited) के साथ 'yesterday' नहीं चलता।

question:
Spot the error.

The old woman requested the young man (A) / that lend her a hand (B) / to cross the busy road. (C)

options.text: The old woman requested the young man

explanation: Request वाले imperative की reporting में 'requested + object + to + V1' आता है: 'requested the young man to lend her a hand'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The principal strictly forbade the students [not to use] mobile phones inside the examination hall.
explanation: 'Forbid' खुद negative अर्थ रखता है, इसलिए उसके बाद 'not' नहीं लगता: 'forbade the students to use'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Rahul [suggested to his friends to go] for a picnic on Sunday.

options.text: suggested to his friends that they should go
suggested to his friends for going

explanation: 'Suggest' के बाद 'to + V1' नहीं आता। 'Let us...' की reporting 'suggested that they should go' से होती है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She exclaimed with joy [that what a beautiful garden it was].

options.text: that how beautiful the garden was
that what beautiful garden it was
that it was a very beautiful garden

explanation: Exclamatory sentence की reporting में 'that' के साथ 'what/how' नहीं आते। उसे assertive बनाकर 'very' लगाते हैं: 'that it was a very beautiful garden'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Rohan told us that he [has been] to Goa the previous month with his family.
explanation: Reporting verb past है और 'the previous month' past marker है, इसलिए Present Perfect → Past Perfect: 'had been'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The receptionist [told that the manager was] in a meeting and could not see anyone before noon.

options.text: said us that the manager was
told us that the manager was

explanation: 'Tell' हमेशा object के साथ आता है ('told us that'); object न हो तो 'said that' आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

Rahul told me that he will go to Delhi the next day (A) / to attend the interview (B) / for the post of a clerk. (C)

options.text: Rahul told me that he will go to Delhi the next day
for the post of a clerk.

explanation: Reporting verb past (told) है और 'the next day' reported speech का marker है, इसलिए 'will go' → 'would go'।

question:
Spot the error.

The coach advised to the players (A) / to practise regularly (B) / before the final match. (C)

options.text: The coach advised to the players

explanation: 'Advise' के बाद सीधे object आता है ('to' नहीं): 'advised the players to practise'।

question:
Spot the error.

The old woman cried with sorrow (A) / that alas she had lost (B) / her only son in the war. (C)

options.text: The old woman cried with sorrow
her only son in the war.

explanation: Alas / Hurrah / Oh जैसे exclamatory words reported speech में हटा दिए जाते हैं और भाव 'with sorrow/joy' से दिखाया जाता है: 'that she had lost'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

My friend asked me whether he [can] borrow my notes the next day.
explanation: Reporting verb past है और 'the next day' marker है, इसलिए modal 'can' → 'could'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The manager told the workers that the factory [shall remain] closed the next day for repairs.
explanation: Reporting verb past होने पर 'shall/will' → 'would' हो जाता है।

question:
Spot the error.

Whenever I call him, (A) / he says that he was very busy (B) / these days with his new job. (C)

options.text: he says that he was very busy
these days with his new job.

explanation: Reporting verb (says) present में है, इसलिए reported clause की tense नहीं बदलती, और 'these days' भी present का marker है: 'he says that he is very busy'।

question:
Spot the error.

On seeing me in the park, he wished me (A) / good morning and asked (B) / how I was doing. (C)

options.text: On seeing me in the park, he wished me

explanation: 'Good morning' जैसी greeting की reporting 'wished me good morning' से होती है और 'how I was doing' में order सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Seeing me in the lane, he asked me (A) / where I was going (B) / so early in the morning. (C)

options.text: Seeing me in the lane, he asked me

explanation: Reported wh-question में statement order (where I was going) और tense backshift दोनों सही हैं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The nurse said that the doctor was busy (A) / and asked me (B) / if could I wait for some time. (C)

options.text: The nurse said that the doctor was busy
if could I wait for some time.

explanation: Reported question में 'if/whether' के बाद सीधा order आता है: 'if I could wait'।

question:
Spot the error.

He thanked to me (A) / for the help I had given (B) / to his family during the crisis. (C)

options.text: for the help I had given
to his family during the crisis.

explanation: 'Thank' के बाद सीधे object आता है (preposition 'to' नहीं): 'He thanked me'।

question:
Spot the error.

The doctor says that (A) / regular exercise keeps a person fit (B) / and prevents many diseases. (C)

options.text: regular exercise keeps a person fit

explanation: Reporting verb present (says) है और बात general truth भी है, इसलिए tense/pronoun में बदलाव की ज़रूरत नहीं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The manager said that the delegation [had arrived] the previous evening and would leave the next morning.
explanation: Reporting verb past है; 'the previous evening' के साथ 'had arrived' और 'the next morning' के साथ 'would leave' दोनों सही हैं। इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He asked me what [do I do] for a living.
explanation: Reported wh-question में statement order आता है और reporting verb past होने पर present → past होता है: 'what I did for a living'।

question:
Spot the error.

This beautiful painting (A) / was made during the summer vacation (B) / by she and her friends. (C)

options.text: was made during the summer vacation

explanation: 'By' (preposition) के बाद object case आता है: 'by she' → 'by her'।

question:
Spot the error.

The thief who had stolen the jewellery has caught by the police (A) / after a long chase through (B) / the crowded streets of the old city. (C)

options.text: The thief who had stolen the jewellery has caught by the police
the crowded streets of the old city.

explanation: Present Perfect Passive = has/have + been + V3। 'has caught' → 'has been caught'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

All the pending dues [must paid] by the employees before the end of this month.
explanation: Modal का passive = modal + be + V3: 'must be paid'।

question:
Spot the error.

When we reached the hospital, (A) / the injured passengers were been treated by the doctors (B) / and their families were waiting outside. (C)

options.text: the injured passengers were been treated by the doctors
and their families were waiting outside.

explanation: Past Continuous Passive = was/were + being + V3। 'were been treated' → 'were being treated'।

question:
Spot the error.

By the end of next year, (A) / the entire flyover project (B) / will have completed by the engineers. (C)

options.text: By the end of next year,
will have completed by the engineers.

explanation: Future Perfect Passive = will have been + V3। 'will have completed' → 'will have been completed'।

question:
Spot the error.

While he was returning home from the market, (A) / the old farmer was beaten badly (B) / by a heavy iron rod. (C)

options.text: While he was returning home from the market,
the old farmer was beaten badly

explanation: Instrument (साधन) के साथ 'with' आता है और कर्ता (agent) के साथ 'by'। 'by a heavy iron rod' → 'with a heavy iron rod'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The old beggar [was laughed by] the children for his funny dress.
explanation: Prepositional verb (laugh at) का preposition passive में भी साथ रहता है: 'was laughed at by'।

question:
Spot the error.

The proposal to ban plastic bags (A) / has been discussed in detail and (B) / will be looked by a special committee. (C)

options.text: The proposal to ban plastic bags
has been discussed in detail and
will be looked by a special committee.

explanation: 'Look into' का 'into' passive में भी रहता है: 'will be looked into by a special committee'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new teacher [is known with] all the students of the school.
explanation: 'Known' के साथ 'to' आता है: 'is known to all the students'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Let the prisoners treated] kindly and given proper food by the jail staff.

options.text: Let the prisoners to be treated

explanation: Imperative का passive 'Let + object + be + V3' से बनता है: 'Let the prisoners be treated'।

question:
Spot the error.

By who was this decision taken (A) / without consulting the members (B) / of the executive committee? (C)

options.text: By who was this decision taken

explanation: Preposition (by) के बाद object case आता है, इसलिए 'who' → 'whom': 'By whom was this decision taken'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[By whom this novel was written] in the early years of the twentieth century?

options.text: By whom was this novel written
By who was this novel written
By whom written was this novel

explanation: Interrogative passive में auxiliary subject से पहले आती है: 'By whom was this novel written?'।

question:
Spot the error.

After the students failed to understand the first time, (A) / the teacher repeated the lesson and (B) / the new formula was explained them clearly. (C)

options.text: After the students failed to understand the first time,
the teacher repeated the lesson and
the new formula was explained them clearly.

explanation: Explain / describe / announce जैसे verbs में person से पहले 'to' लगता है: 'was explained to them'।

question:
Spot the error.

The old man in our locality (A) / is said that he has donated (B) / all his property to charity. (C)

options.text: The old man in our locality
is said that he has donated

explanation: 'Is said' के बाद that-clause नहीं, infinitive आता है: 'is said to have donated' (या 'It is said that he has donated')।

question:
Spot the error.

The young man is resembled by his father (A) / in looks as well as (B) / in the style of speaking. (C)

options.text: The young man is resembled by his father

explanation: Resemble जैसी stative verbs (have, lack, resemble, suit) का passive नहीं बनता: 'The young man resembles his father'।

question:
Spot the error.

The newly formed committee (A) / is consisted of ten members (B) / from different departments. (C)
explanation: 'Consist of' intransitive है, इसका passive नहीं बनता: 'consists of ten members'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The manager wants the report [to submitted] to the head office by Monday.
explanation: Passive infinitive = to + be + V3: 'wants the report to be submitted'।

question:
Spot the error.

The old machines in the factory (A) / have become obsolete and (B) / need to repair before the new production season. (C)

options.text: The old machines in the factory
need to repair before the new production season.

explanation: Machines खुद repair नहीं करतीं, इसलिए passive sense चाहिए: 'need to be repaired' (या 'need repairing')।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She hates [to being asked] the same question repeatedly by the interviewers.
explanation: Passive gerund = being + V3: 'hates being asked'। 'to being' गलत है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new bridge over the river [is going to inaugurated] by the Prime Minister next week.
explanation: 'Be going to' का passive = is/are going to + be + V3: 'is going to be inaugurated'।

question:
Spot the error.

The thief was seen enter the house (A) / by the neighbours (B) / around midnight. (C)

options.text: The thief was seen enter the house

explanation: Active में 'saw him enter' (bare infinitive) होता है, पर passive में 'to + V1' आता है: 'was seen to enter'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

By the time the police arrived, the thieves [had been caught] by the villagers.
explanation: Past Perfect Passive (had been + V3) पहले हुई action के लिए बिल्कुल सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The new highway connecting the two cities (A) / will be inaugurated by the Chief Minister (B) / early next month. (C)

options.text: The new highway connecting the two cities
will be inaugurated by the Chief Minister

explanation: Future Simple Passive = will be + V3, इसलिए 'will be inaugurated' सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The students [were being taught] by an experienced teacher when the fire alarm rang.
explanation: Past Continuous Passive (were being taught) और 'when' वाला clause दोनों सही हैं, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The documents [have been sent] to the head office by speed post this morning.
explanation: Plural subject (documents) के साथ Present Perfect Passive 'have been sent' सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।
